Soft, lightweight cotton poplin makes this pyjama set comfortable for sleeping and relaxed wear at home. Cut to a regular fit with an easy shape, the shirt has an open revere collar, side vents, oversized shell buttons and a single chest pocket, while the trousers have an elasticated waist with an adjustable front drawcord, side-seam pockets and a back patch pocket.

The cotton poplin draws on Sunspel’s longstanding expertise in cotton underwear.
